name: Hour Rap
description: Rap at the instant the hour turns and the foe's guard is between one moment and the next.

name: Foretold Cover
description: Cover the place that the foretold hour says will be struck.

name: Appointed Pace
description: Pace in the ordained gap between two moments where nothing can reach the body.

name: Hour Seeing
description: See the next hour laid out like a map and the places where fate bends it.

name: Deferred Blow
description: Strike a blow that is fated to land a few breaths later and let the fight run on until it does.

name: Slowed Moment
description: Stretch the foe's moment so that each act takes longer than it should.

name: Hour Mending
description: Return an ally or the self a little way along the hour to before the wound was deep so that it closes.

name: Returning Hour
description: Draw back the hour for an ally whose breath has just stopped so that life may return before the short window closes.

name: Predetermined Strike
description: Strike as the hour demands and the blow lands where it was always going to.

name: Reckoned Hour
description: Call the reckoned hour down upon the field so that every foe is struck at the moment fate set for them.

name: Ordained Hour
description: streams: Time + Fate. Bend the river of time with the weight of fate so that the blow is struck at the one hour it was ordained to fall and lands upon the foe whatever they do before it.

name: Wild Rap
description: Rap at no fixed place and trust the wild lot to land it on a weak one.

name: Scattered Cover
description: Scatter the odds about the body so that a blow cannot find the likeliest place.

name: Erratic Stride
description: Stride in a pattern that even fate cannot predict.

name: Disorder Reading
description: Read the one fixed thread that remains among a field of tangled ones.

name: Tumbling Dice
description: Throw a strike like dice that may fall as a graze or as a crushing blow.

name: Muddled Fortune
description: Muddle the foe's fortune so that their trained answers come out wrong.

name: Wild Boon
description: Accept a wild boon from chaos and let it lift the user's strikes in unforeseen ways.

name: Lot Scatter
description: Scatter the foe's sense of which acts will succeed until they hesitate at every choice.

name: Chaotic Doom
description: Cast a doom that has no pattern so that no guard set against doom can stop it.

name: Unwritten Ward
description: Hold a ward that is not written in any pattern of fate and so cannot be read or turned.

name: Upended Odds
description: Upend the odds of every foe in reach so that each fails at the thing they do best.

name: Lot Tempest
description: Cast a tempest of loose lots across the field that fall as ruin upon some and as luck upon others.

name: Unbound Lot
description: streams: Fate + Chaos. Cast a lot that is bound to no pattern so that it falls where neither fate nor chance can say and every foe in reach loses the thread of what is certain.
